components.name: Brand Button
components.description: Primary route from a light surface to technical documentation or status.
components.css: .ds-button-brand { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--colour-brand-deep); color: var(--colour-bg); font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--font-mono); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-button-brand:hover { background: var(--colour-brand); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--colour-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hero Light Button
components.description: High-contrast primary route on the committed moss hero.
components.css: .ds-button-light { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--colour-bg); color: var(--colour-brand-deep); font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--font-mono); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-button-light:hover { background: var(--colour-accent); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-light:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--colour-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: A written design or implementation status with colour as supporting information.
components.css: .ds-status-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.65 0.075 142); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--colour-brand-deep); font: 600 9px/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Source Window
components.description: The primary visual material for source, commands, and result traces.
components.css: .ds-source-window { overflow: hidden; margin: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--colour-code); color: var(--colour-code-ink); } .ds-source-window figcaption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--colour-code-line); color: oklch(0.72 0.025 142); font: 600 9px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-source-window figcaption span { color: var(--colour-accent); } .ds-source-window pre { overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 20px; font: 400 12px/1.75 var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Project Navigation
components.description: A direct project header whose links remain visible and wrap on small screens.
components.html: ModelDocsSource
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font: 500 11px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--colour-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--colour-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface makes OrnaDB feel like a maintained systems manual whose first page also proves the product argument. The design combines the direct project-page structure of PipeWire and Wayland with the stronger product demonstration used by Handy. Real source, result paths, process boundaries, and implementation status provide the visual material.

The frontpage commits to moss green, black, white, and a sharp yellow-green accent. Documentation uses the same identity on a quieter white reading surface. The system rejects generic SaaS landing pages, glossy AI database sites, decorative terminal themes, and editorial-magazine styling.
keyCharacteristics: visible CLIENT, SERVER, protocol, and runtime boundaries
code and architecture as the primary imagery
flat surfaces separated by colour, spacing, and solid rules
restrained motion with a complete reduced-motion path
explicit text labels for implementation and design status

rules.name: The Status Is Text Rule
rules.body: Every status colour has a written label such as IMPLEMENTED, LOCKED, PROPOSAL, or OPEN.

rules.name: The Four-Material Rule
rules.body: Build pages from white, moss, near-black, and yellow-green. Do not add decorative hues to create artificial variety.

rules.name: The Source Has Priority Rule
rules.body: Source stays large enough to read and never becomes a faint background texture.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Depth indicates structure or interaction, never decoration.

dos: Do put valid Orna syntax and copyable commands near the top of the page.
Do show CLIENT, SERVER, runtime, protocol, and security boundaries as labelled structures.
Do use semantic HTML, visible focus, and text labels for every status.
Do keep the documentation visually quieter than the marketing frontpage.
Do state plainly when a feature is locked design, current proposal, open question, or implemented work.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS landing page with conversion funnels, testimonial strips, pricing cards, or inflated claims.
Don't make a glossy AI database site with gradients, abstract blobs, or vague promises.
Don't write a beginner SQL tutorial for an expert audience.
Don't use terminal-themed decoration as a substitute for technical substance.
Don't present a current proposal or roadmap item as a released feature.
Don't use gradient text, glass cards, decorative grids, repeated eyebrow labels, coloured side-stripe borders, or ambient shadows.
Don't round cards, sections, or inputs beyond 8px.
